consequences.scriptCode: const ctx = arguments[1]; const event = ctx.event; const state = ctx.state; if (event.type === 'EntityDied') { const victimId = event.victimId; const comps = state.components.get(victimId); const templateId = comps && comps.Template && comps.Template.templateId; if (templateId === 'barkeeper') { return [{ type: 'spawn_entity', entityTemplateId: 'barkeeper_note', targetId: victimId.toString() }]; } } return [];
